quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within the following distances of any fire hydrant, whether or not the location is posted with a sign, whether or not the adjacent curb or roadway surface is painted red, and whether the location is on public or private property: (a) At a location where parallel parking is permitted, fifteen feet; (b) At a location where angle parking is permitted or no parking is permitted, twenty feet.

activation.condition: Physical fire hydrant and location where parallel parking is permitted.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park within fifteen feet of the hydrant absent a sourced necessity or direction exception.

exceptions.source_clause: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law
the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device

timing.description: Observe the vehicle activity and hydrant throughout the original approach and dwell.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Location-specific municipal parking permission must be reviewed.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original traffic conflict, necessity and lawful response require independent review.
Original officer authority and direction must be reviewed.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: directions of a traffic control device
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original device authority and direction must be reviewed.
